# MediaJack Systems

> MediaJack Systems LLC is a one-person marketing and custom systems firm in Englewood, Colorado, run by Jack Johnson. It plans, makes and runs marketing for local businesses (contractors, salons, restaurants, shops), and builds custom systems for the ones that need them. Based in Englewood, in person around Denver, and by phone, email and video anywhere in the US. Every job is a flat fee, quoted in writing before work starts.

Contact: Jack Johnson, (970) 401-0185, jack@mediajacksystems.com

## Starting prices

- Website for a small business, with a gallery of its work: $500. Hosting and small updates: $50 a month.
- Website for a bigger operation: $1,500. Hosting and updates: $150 a month.
- Fixing the problems on a website a business already has: a flat $295, done within a week, paid when it is done.
- Social media: $150 per platform set up with 4 posts ($200 for bigger operations); 12 posts a month for $100 a month ($300 for bigger operations).
- Print, ads, email and fractional CMO work are quoted for the job. The marketing check-up is free.
- Custom systems are quoted for the job, in writing, before work starts.

## Services

- [Get found](https://mediajacksystems.com/services/#get-found): Google Business Profile, local search, AI search visibility, Google and Facebook/Instagram ads, review routines.
- [Look the part](https://mediajacksystems.com/services/#look-the-part): logos and brand guides, websites and website fixes, landing pages, photo and video.
- [Stay in touch](https://mediajacksystems.com/services/#stay-in-touch): social media, email newsletters and campaigns, follow-ups, content.
- [Put it in their hands](https://mediajacksystems.com/services/#print): business cards, postcards and direct mail (including Every Door Direct Mail), flyers, brochures, signs, banners, vehicle graphics, trade show displays.
- [Run it for you](https://mediajacksystems.com/services/#run-it): fractional CMO work: plan, budget, calendar, vendor management, sales materials, plain-English reporting.
- [Built to order](https://mediajacksystems.com/services/#custom-systems): custom systems, software built around how a business works: tools on a website (calculators, checkers and maps), lead capture and follow-up systems, company platforms built from the ground up, then the marketing to get people using it.
